name: Mizh svitiv ya zustriv tebe
source:
What does it take to turn your life around? 

One chance meeting.

Who can change your whole world? 

One random girl.

And it's up to you to decide what to do with adventures that come out of nowhere.

[from [url=https://crueljulz.itch.io/how-i-met-you]itch.io[/url]]
